item.description: The Tags class constructor has incorrect validation logic that allows invalid arguments like dicts to be processed when they shouldn't be. Specifically, when a dict is passed as an argument, it gets converted to a tag_dict but the validation doesn't properly enforce that only Tags instances or AWSHelperFn should be accepted.
item.contract: The Tags class constructor should validate that when arguments are passed (other than kwargs), they must be either AWSHelperFn instances or dicts that get converted to tag dictionaries, but the overall validation should prevent passing raw dicts directly as arguments to the constructor. The validation should align with the strict validation used in other modules like batch and dynamodb.
